benchmark: MAPLE FreeSolv 10-molecule variational CQEq-GTO/GB polarizable diagnostic
selection_policy: Ten classes fixed before calculation: alkane, aromatic hydrocarbon, alcohol, ether, ketone, ester, nitrile, aromatic amine, haloalkane, sulfoxide.

configuration.charge_profile: CQEq derivative of the full hydrogen-dependent QEq-GTO energy plus OpenMM GB polar quadratic form
configuration.nonlinear_solver: SciPy SLSQP with analytic charge gradient, total-charge constraint, KKT and local-minimum gates
configuration.validation_note: Experimental consistent-QEq continuum coupling. It is variational and force-consistent, but QEq and Amber GB parameters were not jointly fit.
